column1: # The six topic-safety categories for an app aimed at Vietnamese students (docs/reports/voa-classify.md)
# and the stems that flag them (tab-separated: category, regex alternatives matched at the start of a
# word, case-insensitive except where a group says otherwise). The stems were fixed after reading which
# words fired on the 724 passages, twice: "sentenc" matched every grammar sentence and "trump" the
# instrument; then "congress" and "battle" were dropped or narrowed. "president", "government" and
# "democrat" stay literal on purpose: a narrower form fits the passages already read and proves
# nothing about unseen ones (docs/reports/voa-safety-stems.md). A flag is a lead for a
# reader, never a filter: nothing is deleted. The disaster category is also gated in code (classify.py).
